defs.def: the way that sth is done or happens 方式；方法

ex.s: Much in the same manner, we may over the years recite to ourselves poems learnt by heart long ago, which have become part of our self-recognition.
ex.t: 同样地，我们多年来可能会背诵那些很久以前就烂熟于心的诗歌，它们已经成为我们自我认知的一部分。

ex.s: If we keep our body fit, we can enjoy life in a better manner.
ex.t: 如果我们保持身体健康，就能更好地享受生活。

ex.s: I plan to make it in an admirable manner. ”
ex.t: “我打算以令人钦佩的方式完成它。”

ex.s: The researchers call the effect “enclothed cognition,” suggesting that all manner of different clothes probably affect our cognition in many different ways.
ex.t: 研究人员称之为“着装认知”效应，认为各种各样不同的衣服可能以许多不同的方式影响我们的认知。

defs.def: the way that sb behaves towards other people 举止；行为方式
behaviour that is considered to be polite in a particular society or culture 礼貌；礼仪

ex.s: Table manners, however, can differ in different situations.
ex.t: 然而，餐桌礼仪在不同场合可能有所不同。

ex.s: “Small talk is the basis of good manners,” he says.
ex.t: "闲聊是良好礼貌的基础，"他说。

defs.def: the habits and customs of a particular group of people 规矩；习俗
